title: ConsultarSolicitudesFFMM golden FMM-SFM-041_empresa-nula
note: DESVIO-KIT-1, NOT approved and NOT relaxed here: legacy raises NullPointerException (ConfiguracionSistema.getParametroConfiguracionString on an unknown/null company: HashMap.get(...) is null); the new code raises the kit's ParametroNoEncontradoException, which the harness writes as 'Exception: Parametro PLA.FiltroAdministracionCarteraWS en modulo PLATAFORMA no encontrado'. Only the exception line (== excepcion) differs; salidaCruda, tablas, colaboradores, sesion and decisionServlet are identical. The module's SfmEquivalenciaTest relaxes this for the slugs empresa-nula / empresa-sin-configuracion / empresa-ausente; this check does not
